title: TASK_PACKET
description: Fixed input contract for one unit of seat work. A packet is the whole of what a seat is given: who the seat is, which named workflow is being run, what is already sourced, what is not, and where the run must stop. This file is self-contained on purpose: it uses no external $ref, so it can be read and checked without a resolver or a network fetch. Writer is the docs leftover; COO is first QC and the PA last-gates. Candidate-visible.

packet_id.description: Identifier for this packet. Structural only — it carries no company fact.

role_slug.description: One of the 46 seat slugs. A slug outside the list is invalid: there is no forty-seventh seat to address a packet to.

seat_status.description: The seat's recorded status. It must match the roster for the named slug — a packet cannot relabel a parked seat as assigned.

workflow_id.description: The named workflow this packet runs. A workflow has to be named to be run; there is no unnamed default.

audience.description: Who the deliverable is written for. Naming an external audience does not authorise a send — see locks.external_send.

requested_outcome.description: The one outcome this packet asks for, in a sentence.

source_ids.description: Sources the seat may read. An empty array is valid and means no source was supplied — it does not mean the seat may supply its own.

facts.description: Statements that already have a source. Every entry names its source_id. A statement with no source belongs in assumptions or unknowns, never here.

assumptions.description: Statements being worked from that are not sourced. Kept separate from facts so the two never merge.

unknowns.description: What is not recorded. Named missing stays named: an unknown listed here is not to be filled in by the run.

constraints.description: Limits on how the work is done.

allowed_tools.description: Tools the seat may use. An empty array means none, not any.

prohibited_actions.description: What the run may not do. The four baseline tokens are required in every packet, so the locks travel with the work instead of living only in a reviewer's head. Further prohibitions may be added.

form.description: The exact shape asked for — a file, a table, a packet — stated tightly enough that a reviewer can tell whether it arrived.

deliverables.description: Exactly what has to come back. A packet with no deliverable is not a unit of work.

how_checked.description: What a reviewer opens or runs to settle the criterion. Taste is not a check.

approval_points.description: The recorded gate chain: COO first QC, PA last gate. Both must appear. Michael is the third permitted approver and no other approver may be named.

stop_conditions.description: The conditions under which the run stops rather than proceeding. A packet with no stop condition has no floor.

activates_seat.description: No packet activates a seat. Activation is outside this contract, so the only valid value is false.

live_job_requested.description: Whether the packet asks for live job work. It must be false for the parked seats, for the three leftover-only seats with no live job, and for the unassigned seats.

send_requires_michael.description: Nothing goes to a client, a prospect, or the public without Michael. The only valid value is true.

external_send.description: If anything in the packet could leave the company, Michael's sign-off is required and cannot be marked not applicable.

holder.description: The recorded holder of the seat. COO — Anthony C. Garcia — is the only holder recorded anywhere. Every other seat is null, which reads as not recorded, not as vacant-and-fillable-here.

kpi_current.description: KPI Current stays empty. Empty is not 0, so a packet may not carry a current value of any kind, including 0.

applies.description: True for the definition-gated slugs. Set by the roster rule below, not by preference.

definition_recorded.description: What CSO, CCO, and Pendulum mean is not recorded. No packet may declare it recorded, so the only valid value is false.

allOf.$comment: Roster rule — the three leftover-only seats with no live job. A packet asking them for live job work is invalid.
Roster rule — the two parked seats. A packet asking them for live job work is invalid.
Roster rule — the unassigned seats. A leftover existing for a seat does not fill it, unpark it, or hand it a live job.
Definition gate — the packet has to carry the gate as an unknown rather than resolve it.
Holder rule — only the COO seat may carry the one recorded holder. Every other slug carries null.

role_slug.description: The 46 seat slugs, one per seat page.

no_live_role.description: Leftover-file assigned with no live job to run.

definition_gated_role.description: What these three mean is not recorded, and this contract does not settle it.

gate_holder.description: The only approvers this contract knows. No other holder is recorded, so no other may be named.
